notes: One run per configuration, so the ± values show spread across the three evals, not run-to-run variance.

With the skill every run ends with 0 validator errors; without it no run does (missing required pages, folder names such as operator-guide that map to two roles, no landing-page links in the expected form).

Both configurations corrected the seeded drift in the migration eval (port 9000 -> 7070, the non-existent delete command, the undocumented NOTEKEEP_MAX_NOTE_BYTES), so those three assertions do not discriminate.

Honesty about unknown facts discriminates: in add-missing-book the baseline wrote test cases from general accounting rules for a repository with no tests; the skill run left seven pages as drafts and named the missing fact for each.
The skill costs more: about 2x the time and 1.5x the tokens on average, because it writes the full outline (34 pages vs 26 in new-tree) plus repository integration and runs the validator and mdBook.
